title: Looking for feedback on my fantasy investing game
author: Powerful-Storm-9092
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I've been working on a small game called Dungeon Capital.

The idea is to invest in fantasy factions like Goblins, Dwarves and Ghosts, grow your wealth and become the richest investor in the dungeon.

The current version is still a very early prototype. My goal is to turn it into a mobile-first game built around real-time progression rather than constant clicking.

Players can check in throughout the day, read news, manage investments, collect dividends and gradually build a larger investment empire.

You can try the prototype here:

[https://miodri.itch.io/dungeon-capital](https://miodri.itch.io/dungeon-capital)

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the concept and the current prototype.

What would you expect from a game that combines investing mechanics with a fantasy setting?

Thanks for taking a look.

replies.author: Powerful-Storm-9092
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Charts are already on my list and I agree they would make the game much better.

replies.author: Time_Cat_5212
replies.body: I also think it would be cool to invest in guilds or something (companies) instead of just goblin/dwarf/human etc.  Like 5 goblin mining companies competing over something etc

replies.author: Powerful-Storm-9092
replies.body: Thanks! That's actually an idea I've been considering too. Having multiple companies or guilds within each faction, like a Dwarven Syndicate or a Miners' Cartel, could make investing much more interesting.👍
